visual.description: Fixed top nav with logo left, centered 3-item menu with dropdowns, and two CTA buttons right (Log in outlined, Sign up filled).

Dark full-viewport hero with centered headline, subtext, and single CTA button; scattered single lowercase letters float across the background at various opacities creating a typographic texture field.
Centered app dashboard screenshot floats above the fold with device mockups (tablet left, two phones right) partially overlapping the bottom edge of the section on a light background.

Light background section with large left-aligned display text spanning roughly 60% of width; hand-drawn book stack illustration floats upper-left, origami crane upper-right, both decoratively positioned.

Dark section with centered large headline and centered body copy below; collaborator avatars with arrow annotation float upper-left, hand-drawn desk lamp and mug illustrations flank left and right edges.
Three equal-width document cards partially visible at the bottom of the collaboration section, each card showing chapter text content on a blue background.
Black full-width banner strip with all-caps centered label text acting as a section divider.

Light background with large display headline spanning left ~60%, body text positioned right-aligned in the right ~40%; hand-drawn robot illustration lower-left, annotations with arrows floating mid-section.
Light section with hand-drawn object illustrations (gear, crumpled paper balls, coils) scattered at varying sizes and positions across the full width above the trust stat.
Light background with very large centered stat headline and single centered CTA button below.
Dark section with left-aligned headline and CTA button; large hand-drawn open-cabinet illustration positioned right, with a wavy white ground line running across the bottom.
Black footer split into left column (logo + stacked uppercase nav links) and right column (large display quote with attribution); social icons row and legal links row span the full bottom.
